prose.name: Defense: The Medic's Case at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: A travelling medic at the <Place> carries the painkillers for every settlement on her round, and raiders have come for them.
prose.card: I carry the painkillers for every settlement on my round, and someone's found out. I'm at the <Place>. Keep them off me.

beats.objective: Talk to the medic at the <Place>

person.name: Halima Strand
hellos: Not now. Unless you're the help. Are you the help?

_bio.why_there: a travelling medic on her round, carrying every settlement's painkillers (her lines)
_bio.wants: the case kept whole, so every patient on her round gets their medicine (her lines)

greeting: Then listen. Every painkiller for every settlement on my round is in this case, and the people out there want it. Keep them off me until they give up.

reply: Then I'll stay right here behind you. Don't let anyone near the case.

exchanges.prompt: I can assist if you need another pair of hands.
reply: Right now I need your hands on a rifle. Afterwards I'll take all the help I can get.

exchanges.prompt: What do they want with painkillers?
reply: To sell them on, mostly. I'd rather they ended up in my patients than in somebody's pocket.

beats.journal: Raiders are coming for a travelling medic's painkillers at the <Place>. I need to hold them off until they give up.

beats.objective: Protect the medic and her case
beats.journal: Raiders came for a travelling medic's painkillers at the <Place>. I held them off until they gave up.
say: That's the last of them. Everyone on my round gets their medicine this week.

broadcast: I'm in the middle of the site, and I'm the one with the medical case. They'll come at me from the edges, so come straight to me and don't stop to talk to anyone.
_speech: Halima: brisk, warm underneath, no time. A stand-in voice; his ear decides.
